title: VTA DIDs — Keys Rotate — payload
description: Plan and start the planned rotation of one role of a key-role identity: successors staged, switched at the cache horizon, predecessors retired at the end of the overlap. For `update`, the authority moves to its committed routine successor, or the recovery commitment is replaced.

did.description: The key-role identity, by DID (for a `did:scid` identity, the DID without `src`).

role.description: The one role to rotate. `authenticator` is refused (`vta/dids:notApplicableToRole`).

replace.description: Verification methods of the role to rotate. Absent rotates every active key of the role. Not for `update`.

keyType.description: Successors' algorithm. Absent keeps each predecessor's (CONVENTIONS.md §14). Not for `update`.

activatesAt.description: When successors switch in; no earlier than the cache horizon, which is the default. Not for `update`.

overlapUntil.description: End of the overlap; after `activatesAt`. Not for `update`.

autoRetire.description: Whether the VTA retires predecessors itself at `overlapUntil`. Absent reads as true. Not for `update`.

recoveryCommitment.description: `update` only: replace the recovery commitment with this key (CONVENTIONS.md §5.3, §6.5). Absent moves the routine authority and carries the recovery commitment forward.

expectedVersionId.description: Optimistic-concurrency precondition: the version identifier (method profile §3) the caller based this change on, for example `keys/list`'s `versionId`. The VTA MUST refuse with `vta/dids:versionConflict` if the identity has moved past it. Not optional for anything a person looked at.

dryRun.description: Compute and return the preview without writing anything but the plan (CONVENTIONS.md §6.1). Absent reads as false.

previewId.description: Apply exactly the plan a previous dry run of this same request returned, or nothing (CONVENTIONS.md §6.1); what every approval is bound to.

reason.description: Why the change is being made, for the audit trail and for the other approvers. Never published.

Response.title: VTA DIDs — Keys Rotate — response payload

preview.description: Present when `outcome` is `preview`, `pendingApproval` or `awaitingRecoveryProof`: the plan, and what an approval is bound to.

newVersionId.description: Present when `outcome` is `applied`: the version identifier of the change. Pass it as the next change's `expectedVersionId`.

keys.description: Every key whose state this change sets or would set, after the change.
